properties.title: Rattlesnake Graveyard Memorial
properties.text: This memorial is dedicated to all the people buried on this land. People from different cultures lived on 'The Poor Farm' located near here from 1888-1930. After their deaths they were buried, but over the years their grave markers have disappeared.

Lewis and Clark on the Yellowstone
properties.text: This plague, located just in front of the Park City Kwik Stop, tells the story of the site where William Clark and some of the other members of the Corps of Discovery stopped on the Yellowstone River, near Park City, to build canoes.
